title: What is my balance?
header_line: Jose's analysis of a book we are still naming. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: When did you last stop and ask yourself what balance you want, instead of just working?
The message, Jose said, is to be conscious of the balance. Do you want a family? Do you want to be a husband? Do you want to be a good father?
If all you want to do is work, he said, then don't have kids and don't get married, because you are not really making a conscious choice.
Being a good father starts from the moment the child is born.
Jose spoke of anchors. The anchors we drag, he said, we might not be conscious of at a certain moment in our life, but they will come back without a doubt.

groups.heading: The way you speak to your children

lines.text: He said he asks his own kids all the time: how can I be a better father?
The way you speak to your children, he said, is the way they speak to themselves when they are adults. It becomes their inner voice.
It is not what you say, it is how you feel when you say it. They get the feeling.
Sometimes he has caught himself and said: I apologize. I'm irritated. It's not coming from anything you did. It's my issues, my anxiety.
If you keep thinking of long-term goals and you are not focused on the process and the day-to-day celebration, he said, you can get lost in those goals.
You have a job to do to take that voice out of your head. Go back to gratefulness. Go back to breathing. I'm healthy, I'm alive, I'm smart, I can do this. Especially in times of excruciating stress.
Some of us as entrepreneurs are born with a little chip, he said. There is a lot of collateral damage. You thrive from risk. You thrive from the anxiety.
What is my balance, he asked: emotionally, intellectually, and with the people around me? The people around you probably suffer more, so your relationships are very important to pay attention to.
That is the magic of reading these kinds of books, he said. You see how other people make choices. Either I choose to be a good father or an absent father. Either a good husband or not.

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write the areas of your life you want in balance: work, family, health, friends.
Write which one you are giving the least to right now.
Write who around you pays the price when you are all work.
Write one thing you will change this week.
Write three words you will tell yourself when the stress is high: for example, healthy, alive, can do this.

check.q: What did Jose say happens to the way you speak to your children?
What did Jose say entrepreneurs often thrive on?
What did Jose say to do when a harsh voice is in your head?
choices: Go back to gratefulness and breathing

recap: Be conscious of your balance. Your relationships pay for your choices too.
